description: Provenance manifest for .github/skills/**. CI should fail if a skill file's content hash changes without a matching update here in the same PR (blueprint section 61).
_demoNote: This manifest is what makes the 'community Skills are curated, not auto-trusted' policy (blueprint section 61) enforceable instead of just a written rule. NOTE: the actual CI hash-check this file enables is NOT yet wired up in this scaffold's pr-validation.yml — this file exists so that check has something to read once someone adds it. Not JSONC (no // comments) since this is plain JSON — use '_'-prefixed keys like this one for notes instead.

_fieldNotes.path: Path to the Skill file this entry tracks.
_fieldNotes.source: 'internal' if organization-authored, otherwise the name of the external project it was curated from.
_fieldNotes.upstreamReferences: Links reviewed while writing/curating this Skill.
_fieldNotes.reviewedBy: Who approved this Skill's content — replace the placeholder before treating this as a real audit trail.
_fieldNotes.reviewDate: When it was last reviewed against upstream sources.
_fieldNotes.playwrightVersionReviewedAgainst: Pin this to whatever Playwright version was current at review time, so drift is easy to spot later.
